card.title: For Everyone’s Protection
card.instruction: Protect people by creating procedures for them. Turn concern into checklists, permissions, required steps, and increasingly narrow exceptions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you borrow my bicycle, let's rehearse what to do if you wobble. I don't want you hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Which foot? I'll tick that side off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever side I'm falling toward. I need to get to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll practise both sides separately. Until both are signed off, you can borrow it for walking.

mechanism: A converts concern for a bicycle borrower into rehearsed, signed-off fall responses and a restricted walking exception.
confusable: Unlike ordinary practical safety advice, each flexible answer becomes a separate permission step under A's supervision.
comparison: The bicycle alternative turns adaptable balance into two certified sides; the tea alternative turns a simpler option into another appendix.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
